claims.claim: On the opened JD self-operated phone ranking, iPhone 18 Pro 256GB burgundy and iPhone 17 256GB white occupy TOP1 and TOP2 respectively.
claims.counterevidence: JD ranking is a platform snapshot and may be cached or dynamically reordered; displayed comment counts are not exact transaction counts.

claims.claim: REDMI K90 12GB+256GB white is a defensible domestic opportunity sample because it has a strong JD consumer signal plus independent community ownership evidence.
claims.counterevidence: Community review reports gaming, fingerprint-enrollment and system-experience weaknesses.

claims.claim: Under the predefined laptop rule of first two self-operated entries with at least 100000 displayed comments, REDMI Book 14 2025 and Lecoo Battle 7000 are the selected heads.
claims.counterevidence: REDMI Book RAM/SSD are not exposed on the opened list page; comment counts may aggregate variants.

claims.claim: MECHREVO Unbounded 14 2026 is a valid opportunity candidate based on an exact domestic listing, purchaser feedback and additional community hands-on evidence.
claims.counterevidence: The SMZDM article is AI-generated from another source, and a JD purchaser reports repeated black-screen/freeze failures.

claims.claim: The opened JD tablet ranking places iPad 11-inch A16 2025 256GB WLAN silver and 128GB WLAN silver at TOP1 and TOP2.
claims.counterevidence: One platform ranking is not the entire domestic market and displayed review totals may span related variants.

claims.claim: HUAWEI MatePad 11.5 soft-light 12GB+256GB deep-space-gray is a domestic opportunity candidate, but its exact 2026 model-year mapping remains provisional.
claims.counterevidence: JD ranking title does not explicitly state 2026 for the 12GB+256GB variant, and SMZDM reports no product reputation entries for its 2026 wiki page.

claims.claim: Publicly accessible pages were insufficient to verify ordinary, member and targeted-coupon prices for most exact SKUs.
claims.counterevidence: Authenticated or location/store-selected sessions may expose additional prices.

claims.claim: K90 community evidence is materially mixed rather than uniformly positive.
claims.counterevidence: Other community users on the same page report satisfactory overall experience.

claims.claim: The MECHREVO candidate has direct negative consumer evidence concerning black-screen, freezing and crashes.
claims.counterevidence: This is an individual purchaser report and does not establish population-level failure rate.

claims.claim: External community-product reputation evidence for the MatePad 11.5 2026 is thin on the opened SMZDM wiki page.
claims.counterevidence: JD itself contains substantial purchaser-review activity for related MatePad 11.5 variants.

data_gaps: AUTHENTICATED DATA REQUIRED: exact-SKU ordinary price, member price, targeted coupon/subsidy price and seller_id for the nine candidates.
Verify REDMI Book 14 2025 item_id 100167105512 RAM and SSD configuration; current opened ranking only exposes Core 5-210H.
Verify whether JD item_id 100230964203 is specifically the 2026 MatePad 11.5 soft-light 12GB+256GB deep-space-gray model.
Determine whether displayed JD comment totals are SKU-specific or aggregated across related variants before using them quantitatively.
No Tmall/Taobao authenticated transaction data was obtained in this limited pass; this limits cross-platform representativeness.
No overseas SKU price, sales, availability or Temu/AliExpress coverage was queried.
